title: Real lookup misses answered: the stranded query-log findings leave no-fix and the research queue empties
goal: Every query-log finding stranded in no-fix leaves it: the two real misses the kb can answer (F-32e0e03abedf, F-b28d0d79b19b) pack their article on HEAD so learn records them fixed-since; the off-target ones (F-071ee8797647, F-6f7e881cdca1, F-740275aab993) are closed as off the kb's domains with the reason; the research gaps (F-ae2f85ba904e test suite size, F-6ac5244b1e3d a slow suite run once per sprint, F-fe10582bc61f GitHub rulesets) are researched from official sources and claimed or closed --tried; the rules miss (F-80eef23e135d, F-cd5fa1250653) is answered by a tested _self question; and the research queue lists no open gap: F-98c7f667e2cd is claimed and F-384650090243, a project tool defect, becomes a backlog bug and its finding is rejected.
